releaseNotes:
Includes the current features, fixes and improvements from v1.17.58–v1.17.64.

What's new

• Ticket Monitoring for Ticketmaster AU/NZ: watch resale tickets, tickets sold by Ticketmaster (primary), or both, and attempt to reserve matching listings.
• Choose Selected Categories or exact Selected Sections, including inactive map sections. Expand/collapse section groups, select all or clear selections, and save choices separately for each event.
• Set price limits per category or section. Apply price updates only checked sections in that category. Blank or 0 means no price limit; prices are per ticket.
• Choose Maximum available or Fixed quantity. Maximum supports a minimum quantity, even-quantity retry cycles and optional single tickets when the minimum is 1. After confirmed failures, the maximum-to-minimum cycle repeats on the matching listing.
• Auto-refresh defaults ON at 60 seconds for new settings, with an adjustable interval, countdown, last-checked time and same-event automatic-refresh resume. Existing saved intervals are retained.
• Added Settings Preview and Show accessible seating, OFF by default, to hide and exclude identified accessible entries while retaining their saved selections and prices.
• Added a separate Activity Log tab with timestamps, Copy log, Clear log and access to Stop.
• Automatically handles the recognized agreement checkbox and Proceed to Buy while Auto Clicker or Ticket Monitoring is running, including primary and resale flows. No extra approval setting is needed.
• Added diagnostic preview/copy in Settings and Copy diagnostics in Activity Log, with version comparisons, saved-versus-active settings and filter-panel failure evidence. Nothing uploads automatically.

Fixes and improvements

• Wider popup, recognizable mascot, full system and personalized English/Tagalog messages, and compact fixed Start/Stop controls.
• Matched monitoring field sizes and label spacing to Auto Clicker. Category/section grouping is clearer; existing price limits are preserved or migrated.
• Fixed Activity Log flickering. Unchanged polls no longer rebuild the log, and new entries preserve your reading position. Important stopped/error/held status remains visible outside the mascot view.
• Fixed NZ resale ticket-name matching when extra seating descriptions appear in the selection panel.
• Agreement handling matches the checkbox label and paired button rather than notice wording, headings or generated classes. It waits for native button enabling and proceeds once without duplicating the ticket request.
• Confirmed Ticketmaster holds lock the clicker and clear pending retry/recovery state. Recognized post-handoff errors clear stale success/green OK without restarting clicks.
• Retained ticket details remain viewable and copyable through same-event navigation/reloads in the tab session. Historical details are clearly distinguished from a current hold.
• Refresh pauses during reservation attempts. Stop, uncertain responses, CAPTCHA/access restrictions, event changes, held tickets and checkout prevent further automatic actions.

Reload the extension and refresh ticket tabs after updating. Only loaded native listings are checked unless automatic loading is enabled; page filters can hide listings. Section grouping requires supported map/event data, and only identifiable accessible seating can be excluded. Inactive sections do not prove availability. Separate fees may apply. Saved details are not booking confirmation. High-demand review Get Tickets, checkout and payment remain manual. Diagnostics help investigate filter-panel failures; they do not themselves fix the close timeout. Tests use mocked pages, not live reservations; Ticketmaster-side errors and unsupported layouts remain possible.
